verses.text: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go unto the house of Jehovah.

segments.text: I was glad when they said unto me,
Let us go unto the house of Jehovah.

verses.text: Our feet are standing Within thy gates, O Jerusalem,

segments.text: Our feet are standing
Within thy gates, O Jerusalem,

verses.text: Jerusalem, that art builded As a city that is compact together;

segments.text: Jerusalem, that art builded
As a city that is compact together;

verses.text: Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah, For an ordinance for Israel, To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.

segments.text: Whither the tribes go up, even the tribes of Jehovah,
For
an ordinance for Israel,
To give thanks unto the name of Jehovah.

verses.text: For there are set thrones for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.

segments.text: For there are set thrones for judgment,
The thrones of the house of David.

verses.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: They shall prosper that love thee.

segments.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem:
They shall prosper that love thee.

verses.text: Peace be within thy walls, And prosperity within thy palaces.

segments.text: Peace be within thy walls,
And prosperity within thy palaces.

verses.text: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within thee.

segments.text: For my brethren and companions’ sakes,
I will now say, Peace be within thee.

verses.text: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God I will seek thy good.

segments.text: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God
I will seek thy good.

headings.text: A Song of Ascents; of David.
